phase: Phase 3: The track A review set and the scorer (by Thu 2026-11-19)
summary: Round 4 of the security review, delta only. The change over d137057 holds five files: the adversarial round 2 tests, the fake gh, the pick-diffs tests, pick-diffs.ts, and plan.md. pick-diffs.ts adds one bounded constant and one spawn option, so one `gh api --method GET` call can hold 64 MiB of output, and a call over that ceiling fails closed with `pick-diffs: gh api failed`. The spawn still uses array arguments with no shell. No new write path appears and the symlink and set-id refusals are untouched. The fake gh pad modes read the environment only, write only to stdout, and add only trailing whitespace after valid JSON, so they cannot run outside a test. The three single-file suites pass at HEAD. The round 2 nit P3B2-1 carries open.
nonblocking_findings: P3B2-1 [Nit] review-b: nothing enforces the D9 order of the key SHA-256. review-set.ts still computes key_sha256 from the key bytes at lint time, and adjudicate.ts rewrites the key files after the lint, so a lint run before the apply publishes a hash that the apply invalidates. The delta of a4894ae touches neither file. The phase plan controls the order at task 4.13: the apply runs first, then the lint runs again, then the orchestrator commits the manifest. Carries rounds 2 and 3, and round 1 P3B1-6. Non-blocking.

No commit landed after a4894ae during this audit, so I audit a4894ae. The commits in the range are 5252e8f (record checker task 3.12), 78627f5 (adversarial round 2 tests), d00169c (Red 3.13a), 6a16421 (record Red task 3.13a), and a4894ae (Green 3.13b). No docs/assets/data-only publish commit landed.

Delta scope: `git --no-pager diff --stat d137057 a4894ae` holds five files: adversarial-p3.test.ts (91 new lines), fixtures/fakes/gh (10 changed lines), pick-diffs.test.ts (14 new lines), pick-diffs.ts (5 changed lines), and measure/tracks/model_guide/plan.md (20 changed lines). No other harness file changed.

No new write path: the pick-diffs.ts delta adds the constant GH_MAX_BUFFER (64 * 1024 * 1024, a fixed 64 MiB) and the option maxBuffer on the one gh spawn (pick-diffs.ts:69-71 and 174). The write path to <private>/candidates/<owner>__<name>.json is unchanged, and the refuseSymlink guard at pick-diffs.ts:299 and the isPlainSetId guard at pick-diffs.ts:88-92 are unchanged. adjudicate.ts and review-set.ts are not in the delta, so their guards hold as in rounds 2 and 3.

The gh boundary holds: ghApi still builds the fixed argument array (api, --method, GET, path) and spawns with no shell (pick-diffs.ts:172-176). The path always starts with repos/<owner>/<name>/, and owner and name are split and validated (pick-diffs.ts:147-148). The two new tests use the fake gh, and the pick-diffs suite passes 21/21.

The 64 MiB buffer is bounded: it is one fixed constant, not a grown value. When a call exceeds it, spawnSync sets run.error and the tool refuses `pick-diffs: gh api failed` with exit 2 (pick-diffs.ts:177). The failure is closed and prints one line. I ran no tool against the real gh.

The pad modes cannot run outside a test: the fake gh reads FAKE_GH_LIST_PAD and FAKE_GH_DETAIL_PAD from the environment with a default of 0, and it applies a pad only to a list or a commit-detail path (fixtures/fakes/gh lines 58-67). pick-diffs.ts sets neither variable. Probe: the fake gh with no pad variable prints the same canned body as before (4204 bytes, status 0); with FAKE_GH_LIST_PAD set to 5000000 the body is the same JSON plus trailing spaces and stays valid after trim. The pad writes only to stdout.

The new tests use temp folders only: pick-diffs.test.ts builds each child environment from a copy of the parent environment plus the pad variables, so the pad reaches one child only, and each run uses a temp home and a 60 second timeout (pick-diffs.test.ts:140-162). The new tests are P3T1-1 (a commits list over 1 MiB) and P3T1-2 (a commit detail over 1 MiB). adversarial-p3.test.ts uses miniPrivate, miniRaw, and tempDir for its five new tests.

Tests at HEAD, each a single file with `cd harness && npx vitest run model-guide-tests/<file> --configLoader native --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot`, all exit 0: pick-diffs 21/21, leak-check 13/13, and adversarial-p3 28/28 (I also ran the round 4 delta file to confirm the plan claim).

A6: plan.md gains an evidence line that every Phase 3 blocking finding has its fix commit and that P3B1-1 to P3B1-5 are fixed in 0fb247b. That claim holds here: the symlink and set-id refusals are green in review-set 18/18 and adjudicate 20/20 from round 3, and the security suites stay green in this round. measure/tracks.md is not in the delta, so no new resolved-security claim appears.
A2 not applicable and unchanged: the delta adds no publish, preview, or draft-status code, and publish.ts and preview.sh are not in the range.
P3B2-1 carries open: a4894ae changes neither the key_sha256 computation in review-set.ts nor the key write-back in adjudicate.ts, so the D9 order stays a workflow control of task 4.13.

Plan note: the plan line for task 3.13b carries the marker [~] and names the fix commit a4894ae in the task heading, so the task row is in flight and not yet recorded as done. This is a workflow state, not a security defect, and it is not a finding.
